parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Valid values:
Instance: Dataset Accelerator instance.
Slot: slot
parameters.help_zh:
标签所属的资源的类型，取值如下：
Instance：数据集加速实例。
Slot：数据集加速槽
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource to which the tag belongs.
If ResourceType is set to Instance, set this parameter to the ID of a Dataset Accelerator instance. To obtain the instance ID, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html.
If ResourceType is set to Slot, set this parameter to the ID of a slot. To obtain the slot ID, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.help_zh:
标签所属的资源的ID。
当ResourceType为Instance时，需要配置为数据集加速实例ID，如何获取加速实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html。
当ResourceType为Slot时，需要配置为数据集加速槽ID，如何获取数据集加速槽ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.name: resource_id
